note: opener: dark trading room, monitors glowing; push into the centre monitor; 'TRADING' types on its screen
motion: Smooth cinematic dolly-in toward the centre monitor; the candlestick charts on the screens tick upward and glow; city lights twinkle.

note: pedestal under a red velvet cloth with a golden '?'; cloth is pulled → only smoke. Text 'MÉTODO SECRETO' then 'vendehumos'
motion: The red velvet cloth is pulled away upward and flies out of frame, revealing an EMPTY pedestal; thick smoke swirls up where the object should be; dust in the spotlight beam. Static camera with a slow push-in.

motion: The slot machine reels spin fast with motion blur, then stop one by one on the car, the plane and the palm tree; the cabinet lights blink; slow push-in.

note: cinematic chess board, red rim light, camera glides; 'ESTRATEGIA' lands on the board; push into the board → F05 3D chapter
motion: Low cinematic camera gliding slowly along the chess board toward the black king; red rim light flickers; shallow depth of field, haze drifting.

note: bull (green light) vs bear (red light) statues; 'EUFORIA' on the bull side @euforia, 'MIEDO' on the bear side @miedo
motion: The green light pulses on the charging bull and the red light pulses on the roaring bear; smoke rolls across the floor; slow push-in between the two statues; reflections shimmer.

note: arcade cabinet, screen glows 'DEMO' with a score climbing; 'no duele' / no real money; text on the screen
motion: Slow push-in toward the glowing cyan arcade screen, the screen flickers softly like an old CRT; the coloured buttons blink; neon reflections move.

note: money swirling down a drain; 'PERDER MÁS' stamps over it @perder
motion: The water swirls faster into the drain, the dollar bills spin around and get sucked down one by one; ripples and splashes; slow rotating top-down camera.
